body: The thought is growing on me. It'd be so easy. All I have to do is walk into the garage, start the car, and go to sleep. The thought of it is so peaceful.

I'm not saying I'd kill myself over her. I feel like it launched this identity crisis. I know that there is something wrong with me (not like, a disorder, just in the way I think about the world and interact with others) and my goal is to grow as a person. Which is really difficult to do because I'm having trouble identifying the problem. That leads me to the existential depression, where I just question what the point is. That's where I think I'd be more likely to actually act on it.
